# Mega Auto Service | ميغا لخدمة السيارات

> Mega Auto Service (ميغا لخدمة السيارات) is an independent specialist service centre in Doha, Qatar — the dealership alternative («بديل الوكالة») for 17 European and luxury car marques: Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi, Porsche, Volkswagen, MINI, Land Rover, Range Rover, Jaguar, Volvo, Bentley, Rolls-Royce, Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati, Aston Martin and McLaren. Dealership-level diagnostics on official subscriptions, genuine or named premium-alternative parts (the customer chooses), a written dated warranty inside the invoice, and photo/video-documented transparency. In documented cases, customers saved between 62% and 87% versus dealer quotations (compared scopes may differ in parts type and technical solution).

- Address: Building 111, Street 29, Industrial Area, Doha, Qatar — P.O. Box 45552
- Phone: +974 4421 1311 · WhatsApp: +974 5011 3444 (primary contact channel)
- Hours: Saturday–Wednesday 8:00–18:00, Thursday 8:00–14:00, Friday closed
- Map: https://maps.google.com/?q=25.192484,51.444534
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/megaauto.qa
- Languages: Arabic, English

## Payment & Discounts (key facts)
- Installments available through PayLater.
- Discounts for approved cardholders — Golalita program cards: Al Rayan Rewards, AlRayan Bank, Al Dar, QLM, Gulf Exchange, Golalita Rewards, Hayyakum, Lusail Elites, Imtenan – QCB — per each card's approved terms and conditions.
- Discounts for Imtiaz cardholders (Ministry of Interior & Internal Security Force / Lekhwiya) per approved terms.
- Payment methods: cash, card, bank transfer, Fawran, American Express, PayLater installments.
- Details: https://megaautoqa.com/offers/ (AR) · https://megaautoqa.com/en/offers/ (EN)

## Notes
- MEGA Auto Service is an independent service centre, not affiliated with, authorised, or endorsed by any vehicle manufacturer. All trademarks belong to their owners.
- Pricing is individual and issued in writing after inspection — MEGA does not publish fixed price lists.
